detail.title: Keep bounded source intake and FKDB artifact provenance auditable
detail.description:
Purpose: connect the existing goal-directed intake obligations with a reviewable source/evidence record and optional FKDB-compatible artifact transfer.

Acceptance criteria:

* Retain the declared goal, source identity, literal source material or recoverable pointer/hash, qualification method, acquisition cost/budget, and unresolved remainder for each admitted record.
* Keep lexical/metadata heuristics distinguishable from semantic verification; neither an index match nor a source relation promotes an evidence status.
* Demonstrate or explicitly defer the transfer of one actual Episteme source/evaluation artifact through the reviewed FKDB ToolCarrier contract; preserve exact source identity and the claim ceiling.
* Record that the current FKDB Supabase/Railway adapters collect local repository artifacts and do not observe applied database or live deployment state.
* Preserve the observed Supabase projects\[\] access limit; no database write, new hosted project, paid resource, or live-sync claim is included in this issue's acceptance.

Grounded sources: redogit/Other-Projects- at 4a05785e4376c558ed7ad761f89db9dd241bca7b, tools/fkdb_adapter_supabase.py, tools/fkdb_adapter_railway.py, and tools/fkdb_local_tool_bridge.py. Complete local read evidence is in evidence/progression/supports-read-evidence.json.
